whyOnekof.label: Maxaa Onekof
whyOnekof.heading1: Qalabka ajnabiga ah adiga laguu dhisin.
whyOnekof.subtitle: Jira kama aqoonsana Bagumeeta. Asana kuma hadli karto Amxaarik. Trello raadraaci kari maayo Birr. Onekof dhammaantaas wuu qaban karaa — iyo wax ka badan.
whyOnekof.ethiopianCalendarDesc: Kalandar dhalashada ah oo 13 bilood leh oo leh maalmaha fasaxa, magacyada bilaha Amxaariga, iyo qorshaynta sprint-ka.
whyOnekof.fourLanguagesDesc: Amxaarik, Afaan Oromoo, Tigrinya, iyo Ingiriisi. Aadanaha ayaa tarjumay, mashiinku ma sameynin.
whyOnekof.etbBudgetTrackingDesc: Birr kasta raadraac. Miisaaniyado samee, kharashyada ansiixi, oo warbixinno dhaqaale soo saar.
whyOnekof.aiDocProcessorDesc: Qandaraasyo & soo jeedimo soo rar. AI wuxuu soo saaraa wakhtiyada, khataraha calaamadeeyaa, hawlaha ku xidhaa.
whyOnekof.customWorkflows: Socodka shaqo ee la habeyn karo
whyOnekof.customWorkflowsDesc: Dhisaha otomaatikga ee hay'adaha Itoobiya — dawlad, gaarka ah, hay'adaha aan-dawliga ahayn, dhismo.
whyOnekof.enterpriseSecurityDesc: RBAC, 2FA, diiwaanka hubinta, maaraynta fadhiga, iyo kaabayaasha SOC 2 diyaar ah.

help.faqCreateProjectAnswer: U gudub bogga mashruucyada oo guji badhanka "Mashruuc samee". Buuxi faahfaahinta mashruuca oo dooro qaabka aad rabto.
help.faqInviteMembersAnswer: U tag Dejinta → Xubnaha Kooxda oo guji "Xubin Caasimo". Geli iimeylkooda oo u xilsaar door.
help.faqCustomizeDashboardAnswer: Maamulayaashu waxay habeyn karaan astaamaha dashboorkka iyaga oo taga Dejinta → Habaynta. Waxaad daar ama dami kartaa qaybaha iyo astaamaha hay'addaada u baahan.
help.faqExportDataAnswer: Bogagga badankood waxay leeyihiin badhanka dhoofinta oo ku yaal qalabka. Guji si aad xogta ugu soo dejiso qaab CSV ama Excel ah.
